title: Give each Tarium member an independent ontology and specimen showcase
abstract: Every project explicitly admitted to Tarium must maintain its own ontology and public-facing website demonstrating representative ontology specimens. A central registry does not replace these per-project resources.
unresolved: This specimen does not itself authorize enrollment of any repository in Tarium.
